decision: research only; not enabled in routing
verticalDatum: DHHN2016 (provider definition; LAS header has no CRS VLR)

laser.gpsTimeEncoding: LAS adjusted standard GPS time; +1e9 seconds since 1980-01-06, minus 18s GPS-UTC

screening.method: Class-20 returns >2m above DGM1; rendered CIR red-green channel contrast >0.10 at each return. This is a candidate screen, not calibrated NDVI or validated classification.

blockers: Laser returns observed in winter 2022; imagery in summer 2024. Growth, removal, construction and seasonal state can disagree.
Class 20 includes non-vegetation objects; rendered colour contrast alone cannot validate individual crowns or vertical foliage gaps.
Require matched epoch DOM/CIR/laser checks, explicit roof/wire/vehicle rejection and stratified canopy/source audits before enabling.
